title: Cypress Breeze
meta_description: Experience Cypress Breeze, an unforgettable getaway accommodating up to 17 guests. Cypress Breeze offers luxurious resort-style living with a community pool, covered patio, fire pit, and 5 bedrooms.
description_expanded:
Cypress Breeze, nestled in the coveted gated community of Cypress Breeze Plantation, invites you to elevate your stay on the stunning Emerald Coast of Florida. With 5 bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, this luxurious abode invites your group to harmonize in fun and relaxation. Enjoy a convenient location less than a mile from the beach.

As you step inside, Cypress Breeze greets you with an open floor plan and exquisite interior. The bright, beautiful interior boasts luxurious finishes and rustic accents, to create the ideal elevated home-away-from-home feel. Indulge in relaxation in the cozy living area, complete with a plush sectional, inviting fireplace, and entertainment system -- perfect for movie marathons or lively game nights with your group.

Channel your inner chef in the stunning kitchen, boasting top-of-the-line appliances, a spacious island with barstool seating, and elegant marble countertop finishes. Adjacent to the kitchen, the dining area provides the ideal setting for shared meals and cherished memories with family and friends.

Cypress Breeze offers spacious and comfortable accommodations for your group of up to 18. The primary bedroom and Bedrooms 2 \& 3 offer a private retreat, each with an ensuite bathroom. Bedrooms 4 \& 5 provide multiple beds and ample space, perfect for kids.

The large, resort-style pool will attract the whole crew for fun-filled days in the sun. Those seeking serenity can retreat to the upper balcony just steps away, without missing out on the family fun. Unwind with an evening cocktail on the covered patio, before you fire up the grill for the ultimate BBQ. End the night around the fireplace, roasting marshmallows and sharing stories.

Embark on an unforgettable getaway at Cypress Breeze, where luxury and relaxation harmonize effortlessly. With its spacious accommodations and array of amenities catering to both kids and adults, this stunning home promises to create cherished memories for your entire group.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Hub 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Laguna Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Located in the Cypress Breeze Plantation gated community
- Please note our occupancy includes an additional two beyond bed count. Trifold floor mattresses and additional linens can be provided upon request.
- Please note that the pool is not heated.

Parking Details:
- 4 compact cars can be parked on the driveway.
- No garage parking.
- No parking on the lawn or on the street.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
